about.text: pale cream English cheddar cheese, made using pasteurised cow's milk marbled with a wine, often a Bordeaux wine or a blend of port wine and brandy.

sources.text: Cheddar marbled with wine (Bordeaux, or port and brandy); Long Clawson Dairy, Leicestershire, since 1969; pasteurised milk; ripening not stated
